text:
Maya: Heads-up — CoreWave renewal hits EOM. Procurement just asked for a PO but they also want the payment window moved to net60. Risk: seats are flat and usage dipped 12% last month. 
Devin: @Maya thanks. Are they asking to change the whole contract to net60 or just delay first payment? Any note from the CFO? :thinking_face:
Maya: CFO email says they need net60 across the invoice schedule for this fiscal quarter. They also flagged vendor code mismatch on our invoice.
Lisa: FYI finance needs the billing entity + tax ID to emit a PO. If we change terms to net60 we need SO/Acct approval for extended payment terms. I can run the approvals but need the vendor code and a negotiation note.
Maya: vendor code is CWER-44 (per their procurement email) — forwarding the thread to you, @Lisa.
procurement-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/0a1b2c3 — addendum draft attached (9mo midterm option + net60 clause).
Sam: If we go 9mo midterm + training push, we should schedule a 2-session enablement series before renewal to try to recover usage. I can run a focused playbook for their platform team. Open slots next Tue/Thu.
Devin: Proposal: offer a 9-month bridge term, 10% early-commit credit, keep per-seat pricing the same, grant two enablement sessions. That buys time for them to stabilize spend and gives us PO + signature. Thoughts?
Lisa: That sounds workable. Approvals: I need the signed addendum + customer billing entity and a short finance memo for net60. If they sign the DocuSign envelope today we can queue the PO and set payment terms in billing.
Maya: I'm pinging the customer right now with the addendum and two date options for enablement. Also asking them to confirm billing entity and tax ID.
Devin: Nice. I'll follow up with a short commercial note to explain the credit and the intent.
Maya: Quick risk callout — if they refuse the midterm and insist on net60 for 12mo we need legal/finance signoff; flagging as medium churn risk until we have a signed PO.
Sam: Noted. I'll draft the enablement agenda tailored to their low-usage cohorts and attach to the DocuSign packet so they see the immediate ROI.
procurement-bot: DocuSign status: Sent -> Viewed by corewave.cfo@corewave.com at 1798769995.
Maya: Great — if we get signature today Lisa can finalize terms and we schedule training next week. I'll update this thread with the signed copy. :thumbsup:
